headline.title: How ChatGPT adoption broadened in early 2026
headline.summary: In Q1 2026, ChatGPT experienced significant adoption growth, particularly among users aged 35 and older, with a more balanced gender distribution. This trend indicates a shift towards broader mainstream acceptance of AI technologies.

articles.title: Riding an AI rally, Robinhood preps second retail venture IPO
articles.summary: Robinhood has confidentially filed for its second retail venture fund, focusing on investments in growth and early-stage startups. This move comes as the company seeks to capitalize on the ongoing interest in AI-driven ventures.

articles.title: Thinking Machines wants to build an AI that actually listens while it talks
articles.summary: Thinking Machines is developing an AI model designed to process input and generate responses simultaneously, aiming to create a more conversational interaction akin to a phone call. This approach contrasts with traditional AI models, which operate in a sequential manner where one party speaks and the other listens.

articles.title: Ilya Sutskever Stands by His Role in Sam Altman’s OpenAI Ouster: ‘I Didn’t Want It to Be Destroyed’
articles.summary: Ilya Sutskever defended his actions during the ousting of Sam Altman from OpenAI, stating he did not want the organization to be destroyed. His testimony on Monday highlighted his continued concern for the company's future despite his estrangement from it.

articles.title: Results and Retrospective Analysis of the CODS 2025 AssetOpsBench Challenge
articles.summary: The article provides a retrospective analysis of the CODS 2025 AssetOpsBench Challenge, focusing on the evaluation metrics, hidden evaluations, and design patterns that influenced the competition outcomes. It details the participation of 149 teams and examines the final rankings and submission data to draw insights into the competition's structure and results.

articles.title: C2L-Net: A Data-Driven Model for State-of-Charge Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries During Discharge
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced C2L-Net, a data-driven model designed to improve the accuracy of state-of-charge (SOC) estimation for lithium-ion batteries during discharge. This model aims to reduce computational costs and eliminate positional bias associated with long historical input sequences in existing methods.

articles.title: M$^3$: Reframing Training Measures for Discretized Physical Simulations
articles.summary: The article presents M$^3$ (Multi-scale Morton Measure), a new framework designed to improve the training of neural surrogate models for physical simulations by addressing measure-induced bias and spatial inconsistencies. By partitioning space based on physical variation, M$^3$ aims to provide a more balanced approach to training measures in discretized continuous domains.

articles.title: Latency Analysis and Optimization of Alpamayo 1 via Efficient Trajectory Generation
articles.summary: The article presents a latency analysis and optimization study for Alpamayo 1, focusing on efficient trajectory generation in reasoning-based end-to-end autonomous driving systems. It categorizes trajectory generation methods into multi-reasoning and other approaches, highlighting their potential to improve the interpretability of driving decisions.

articles.title: Re$^2$Math: Benchmarking Theorem Retrieval in Research-Level Mathematics
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced Re$^2$Math, a benchmark designed to assess the ability of large language models to retrieve theorems and relevant literature in research-level mathematics. The study emphasizes the importance of source-grounded reasoning in mathematical proofs, particularly when determining the applicability of existing tools and lemmas.

articles.title: Cplus2ASP: Computing Action Language C+ in Answer Set Programming
articles.summary: The article announces Version 2 of Cplus2ASP, a system that implements the definite fragment of action language C+ and is compatible with the Causal Calculator Version 2. The new version offers improved speed through modern answer set solving techniques and incorporates recent theoretical advancements in its translation process.

articles.title: M2A: Synergizing Mathematical and Agentic Reasoning in Large Language Models
articles.summary: The article discusses the M2A framework, which aims to integrate mathematical and agentic reasoning within large language models (LLMs) to address the misalignment in reasoning patterns for different scenarios. It highlights the distinct requirements of mathematical reasoning for closed-world problems and agentic reasoning for interactive, multi-turn tasks.

articles.title: LLM4Branch: Large Language Model for Discovering Efficient Branching Policies of Integer Programs
articles.summary: The article introduces LLM4Branch, a large language model designed to discover efficient branching policies for Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solvers, addressing the limitations of traditional hand-crafted heuristics. By leveraging machine learning, LLM4Branch aims to automate the design of these policies without relying on costly expert demonstrations, while also bridging the gap between training objectives and overall solver performance.
